body:
maya r.: Hey ops team — we need a concise cross-cloud provisioning checklist for a new org that will run GPU inference (A100/RTX), must span AWS+GCP+Azure. Goal: avoid surprises when we request quotas and set up networking/tags/billing. Can someone sketch a checklist + a support request template we can reuse?

liam (infra): +1. I'll drop a checklist skeleton. Keep it practical: quotas (GPUs, ENIs, IPs), preferred regions, resource naming/tags, billing link, IAM roles, VPC/subnet design, NAT/egress, service endpoints, monitoring hooks. Also include cost-estimate step.

liam (infra): Checklist (short):
1) Org/account/project creation: create org root -> billing account -> projects/accounts per env (dev/stage/prod).
2) Billing setup: attach billing account, set alerts (budget + 10/50/100%). Add billing export to BigQuery/S3.
3) IAM: bootstrap admins, restricted service accounts for infra, least-privilege roles, enable credential rotation. Example roles: Compute Admin, Service Account Token Creator, Storage Admin (for model artifacts).
4) Quotas to request BEFORE provisioning: GPU quota (A100, V100), vCPUs, regional SSD IOPS, ENIs / Azure NIC limits, public IP quotas, subnetwork IPs.
5) Networking: VPC per environment, multi-AZ subnets, private control-plane endpoints, NAT gateways (or egress proxy), firewall rules, route53/Cloud DNS plan.
6) Regional capacity & reservations: check GPU availability per zone, request capacity reservations or placement groups if needed.
7) Security: KMS/HSM keys, private key rotation, logging/Audit Logging, enable OS hardening baseline images.
8) Observability: perf dashboards, token-level cost tagging, export metrics to central Prometheus/Datadog, enable flow logs.
9) Tagging/naming: org-id, project, team, cost-center, env, owner. Enforce via policy (org policies / Azure Policy).
10) Cost control: enable quotas, set alerts, pre-approved instance types, use spot/preemptible with fallback policies.

liam (infra): Quick support templates (paste into provider support):

AWS support request:
Subject: Quota increase request — GPUs + ENIs for new Redwood org (account: 123456789012)
Body:
We are provisioning a new production account for Redwood Inference and require increased service quotas in region us-west-2. Please increase the following limits:
- G4dn/A10g/A100 (or specific instance family) GPU instances: desired 20 on-demand, 50 spot
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs): increase to 200
- Elastic IPs: increase to 25
- EBS gp3 IOPS baseline: 20000
Reason: provisioning inference fleet for low-latency model serving across multiple AZs. We expect steady-state throughput supporting ~150 concurrent sessions. Contact: infra@redwood.ai

GCP support request:
Subject: Quota increase request — GPUs and external IPs for project redwood-prod (billing: BILLING_ID)
Body:
Please increase quotas in region us-central1:
- A100 GPUs: 30 (quota type: "NVIDIA_TESLA_A100")
- VCPUs (for non-GPU machines): 1000
- Static External IP addresses: 30
We will be deploying inference clusters and need capacity reservation. Contact: infra@redwood.ai

Azure support request:
Subject: Service quota request — GPU VMs and NICs for subscription SUB_ID
Body:
Requesting increased quota in West US 2:
- Standard_NVv4/NCasT4_v3 GPU vCPU quota: 400 vCPUs (equiv)
- Network Interfaces: 300
- Public IPs: 30
Please advise on region capacity and ability to reserve VMs/reserved instances. Contact: infra@redwood.ai

sophia: Add tagging policy snippet: every resource must include tags: {"org": "redwood", "team": "<team>", "env": "dev|stg|prod", "cost_center": "<cc>"}. Enforce via org policy / policy-as-code. Also require billing_export and cost_allocation keys on projects.

arjun: Heads-up on region constraints — capacity for A100 often limited in smaller regions. Action items: verify instance availability API or use provider partner/vendor to confirm stock. If planning bursty scaling, request capacity reservations and consider dedicated capacity (AWS EC2 Fleet Reserved Instances or GCP sole tenancy).

arjun: Also add networking quota checks: AWS VPCs default ENI limit per AZ, IGW throughput for NAT gateways, GCP regional DNS record limits. For egress heavy workloads check outbound bandwidth per instance and request service quotas for NAT gateway throughput or use NAT GW autoscaling.

jen: IAM specifics: create cross-project service accounts with only these roles: Compute Instance Admin (or equivalent), KMS CryptoKey Encrypter/Decrypter, Logging Writer, Monitoring Metric Writer. Rotate keys monthly. Lock down metadata service access on instances where possible.

liam (infra): Sample Terraform precheck (paste into ops repo):
```
# verify quotas
data "aws_servicequotas_service_quota" "gpus" {
  service_code = "ec2"
  quota_name   = "Running On-Demand G4dn instances"
}
```
Replace with corresponding provider modules for GCP/Azure.

maya r.: Awesome — can someone add the email templates to the infra docs repo? Also need someone to volunteer to run the first quota requests and follow up with providers.

liam (infra): I'll take AWS + GCP this week. Will attach case numbers once created.

ops-bot: Reminder: runbook "cloud-account-provisioning" assigned to liam (infra) — due in 3 days.

maya r.: Thanks all. Please keep replies to short checklist additions or urgent caveats.
